policy.allowed_gap_rule: A gap may remain open during Phase 16d because this phase defines release gates; the downstream platform phase must close or explicitly defer the gap before claiming release readiness.
policy.release_blocker_rule: If a platform phase claims public release readiness and the platform policy marks physical hardware as blocked_without_hardware, an unresolved physical-device gap is release-blocking.
policy.evidence_rule: Gap closure evidence must include platform ID, device model, OS/firmware version, app/build identifier, smoke script result, and media capability summary.

gaps.gap: Physical Android handset evidence can be collected in Phase 17 reuse work or mobile hardening.
Physical iPhone/iOS playback evidence is required before iOS mobile release claim.
Physical Windows media-key/HDR evidence is required only if those capabilities are claimed.
gaps.required_before: Windows desktop release claim with media-key/HDR support

gaps.gap: Apple silicon physical Mac evidence is required before signed macOS release claim.
Second distro/display-stack evidence is best-effort unless that distro/package is claimed.

Physical Google TV/Android TV device evidence is required before Android TV release claim; NVIDIA SHIELD TV or SHIELD TV Pro evidence is additionally required before a high-capability SHIELD claim, while Sony BRAVIA Google TV and Android TV evidence closes the Phase 17 Sony hardware gate.
gaps.required_before: Phase 17 release claim, SHIELD high-capability claim, or Sony BRAVIA compatibility claim

gaps.gap: Physical Fire TV hardware evidence is required before Fire TV release claim.
Physical Roku device evidence is required before Roku release claim.
Physical or Remote Test Lab Samsung TV evidence is required before Samsung release claim.
Physical LG webOS TV evidence is required before LG release claim.
Apple TV 4K hardware evidence is required before tvOS release claim.
Xbox Series hardware evidence is required before Xbox release claim.
